title: Classification of (uncolored) bonded knots and links
summary: We present a systematic classification of uncolored bonded knots with singularity number at most seven. Bonded knots provide a topological model for closed protein chains with intramolecular bridges, such as disulfide bonds. Following the tradition of knot tabulation, we describe a procedure based on the generation of planar graphs, their conversion into bonded knot diagrams, and the use of the Yamada polynomial together with brute-force Reidemeister moves to distinguish topological knotted types.
